svg.text: Full-stack web & mobile academic collaboration platform
REST API communication · HTTPS/JSON · JWT bearer tokens
Business logic · input validation · permission checks · serializers (DRF)
Email dispatch · notification fanout · file processing · payment webhooks
PostgreSQL · relational · JSON fields for flexible schemas
Push notifications: Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) · APNs (iOS) · Web Push
Redis caches session · email verification link sent on register
Notification fanout via Celery queue · answers stored as JSON array
File URL + size + pages + subjects JSON saved · views/likes tracked
Webhook confirms payment · seller notified via Notification service · buyer receipt sent
Contact shared via WhatsApp link / phone · status: pending → accepted / rejected
Max members enforced · role assigned · WhatsApp group link optionally shared
